name: safetydeck
description: Local-first security checklist generator for Markdown action plans.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate --profile examples/profiles/solo-founder.json --template examples/templates/startup-baseline.json --output tmp/smoke-plan.md && test -s tmp/smoke-plan.md
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
